hits.title: Ask HN: How are you doing RAG locally?
hits.text: Curious what people use for local retrieval without running a vector DB. I tried Chroma in a sidecar but it doubles memory and I just want search over ~5k markdown files.
hits.author: mkoryak

hits.title: Ask HN: How are you doing RAG locally?
hits.text: sqlite-vec + a quantized MiniLM. Works, but the embedding step is what kills you. Reindexing my Obsidian vault after a sync takes ~6 minutes on an M1 and the app is basically frozen during it.
hits.author: jtwaleson

hits.title: Ask HN: How are you doing RAG locally?
hits.text: We ship a voice agent and every retrieval hop to our hosted vector DB was 60-120 ms. In a voice turn that is the difference between natural and awkward. We ended up keeping a small index in-process and refreshing it every few minutes.
hits.author: dsmurrell

hits.title: Show HN: semlocal - local semantic search for your notes, no vector DB
hits.text: I wanted semantic search over my notes without running a server. semlocal embeds markdown with a small model and keeps vectors in one file next to your vault.
hits.author: Minitour

hits.title: Show HN: semlocal - local semantic search for your notes, no vector DB
hits.text: Does it reindex incrementally? Smart Connections re-embeds half my vault whenever I rename a folder. That is the single most annoying thing about local semantic search right now.
hits.author: kepano_fan

hits.title: WASM embeddings are fast enough now. Indexing is not.
hits.text: Benchmarks of MiniLM in WASM SIMD vs WebGPU across browsers. Per-sentence inference is ~20 ms; the problem is building and persisting the index for 50k chunks in IndexedDB.
hits.author: xenova_watch

hits.title: WASM embeddings are fast enough now. Indexing is not.
hits.text: Same experience building offline search for a Tauri note app. Inference is fine; persisting the HNSW graph and loading it on startup takes longer than the user is willing to wait.
hits.author: hbrndt

hits.title: Our voice agent latency budget, line by line
hits.text: STT 180 ms, retrieval 140 ms, LLM first token 260 ms, TTS first byte 120 ms. Retrieval was the only piece we fully controlled, so we moved it in-process.
hits.author: pipecat_dev

hits.title: Our voice agent latency budget, line by line
hits.text: pgvector over a private link gave us 18 ms p50 but 90 ms p99 under load. For voice it's the tail that users notice. Would pay for something embedded that just works.
hits.author: lsorber

hits.title: Ask HN: Semantic search on the edge without cold starts?
hits.text: Our edge function loads a 23 MB model on every cold start, adding ~700 ms. Precomputing embeddings helps for docs but not for user queries.
hits.author: edgecase_io

hits.title: Ask HN: What's your stack for docs search in 2026?
hits.text: Algolia for keywords, but users type questions now. We tried client-side vectors; index size in the bundle was the blocker for a 3k-page docs site.
hits.author: rauchg_fan

hits.title: Replacing substring search with embeddings in a React Native app
hits.text: Write-up of moving a notes app from substring matching to on-device embeddings: model size, battery, and why we cap the index at 10k chunks.
